Offboarding.title: Employee offboarding
Offboarding.ownershipReview: The selected successor is unavailable. Workspace ownership needs review before normal access can resume.
Offboarding.unconfirmed: The result is unconfirmed. The original request is kept and editing is locked. Recover that result before making another change.
Offboarding.noSuccessor: No eligible member can receive ownership. Invite an active nonguest member before offboarding the owner.
Offboarding.scheduledImpact: Access continues until the workspace’s end boundary. Completion is applied by the explicit mock lifecycle run.
Offboarding.completedImpact: Access to this workspace and its tools has ended. The person’s other workspaces remain available.
Offboarding.finalPayMock: Final-pay completion records an administrative review in this mock. It does not issue a payment.
Offboarding.lastDayHint: Access is retained through this date in the workspace timezone and ends at the start of the following day.
Offboarding.nowImpact: Confirming ends workspace access immediately. Assigned seats are released and pending invitations are cancelled.
Offboarding.dateImpact: The scheduled date ends workspace access after the last working day. You can cancel before completion.
Offboarding.preserve: The global account, historical records and access to other workspaces are preserved.
Offboarding.seatImpact: Ownership never grants a free tool seat. Existing tool assignments determine which responsibilities can be transferred.
Offboarding.custodyHint: Only a successor with existing access to each tool can receive its records. Other records are archived for review.

success.completed: Workspace access ended. Equipment and final-pay actions can still be tracked below.
success.scheduled: Offboarding scheduled. Access remains until the end boundary.
success.cancelled: Scheduled offboarding cancelled. Access is preserved.

errors.date: Choose a valid date from the workspace’s current business day onward.
errors.successor: Choose an active nonguest successor for the workspace owner.
errors.workspace: Return to the original workspace to review or recover this request.
errors.forbidden: You cannot manage offboarding for this employee with your current workspace access.
errors.readOnly: This workspace or session is read-only. Ask an authorized administrator to review access.
errors.gone: This employment record is no longer available.
errors.conflict: The employment state changed. Refresh and review it before trying again.
errors.invalid: Review the end date and successor, then try again.
errors.failed: The request could not be completed. Review the details and try again.
errors.uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Recover the original request to check it safely.
errors.load: Offboarding details could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

Offboarding.successorWarning: The planned successor is no longer eligible. Cancel the schedule and choose an active successor before the end boundary.

staffProtection.authority: Offboarding ends OrgTik staff app access. Rehire does not restore staff authority; a separate authorized reappointment is required.
staffProtection.qualified: Another qualified super administrator is active now. Their status is checked again for the chosen end date and when offboarding becomes due.
staffProtection.noReplacement: Another qualified active OrgTik super administrator must already be in place. Transferring workspace ownership does not assign this staff role.
staffProtection.recovery: OrgTik administrative recovery is required. Departed staff access remains revoked; no staff role was assigned automatically.
